messages:
devops-jen: deploy-bot queued a rollout to HeliosFinance (Dedicated df-prod-7) for runtime v3.3.0. Change window proposed: Thu 2026-03-05 02:00-04:00 UTC. Need approvals for canary %, rollback plan, and KMS checks.
pm-lina: tagging this for release planning sync — do we have a pinned model/runtime combo for Helios? customer asked for deterministic versioning last time.
cs-tom: FYI I told Helios we aim for early March and asked them to reserve the 02:00-04:00 UTC window. They're OK with 10% canary then full rollout if green.
security-claire: quick checklist: KMS key rotation completed? HSM access logs reviewed? We need explicit confirmation before approving production rollout.
infra-ron: KMS rotation done yesterday night, logs sent to security. Also note df-prod-7 has 3-gpu hosts with mixed quantized kernels — we should pin kernel profile rtx-q2 for this rollout to avoid perf variability.
eng-sre-amir: rollback time objective: 15 minutes to revert to v3.2.1 image and routing. Confirmed we have snapshot of KV cache prefix for Helios for fast warm start. But need canary abort thresholds: errors >1.5% or p50 latency regress >200ms.
pm-lina: agree thresholds. Also request a short release note blurb (1-2 bullets) for Helios CS and ops.
deploy-bot: [auto] Rollout draft created: customer=HeliosFinance, cluster=df-prod-7, from=v3.2.1 -> to=v3.3.0, canary=10%, stage=canary->gradual, scheduled=2026-03-05T02:00:00Z, rollback_cmd=`/deploy rollback df-prod-7 --to v3.2.1`.
cs-tom: Helios ops wants a pre-checklist run at T-24h and a final shadow run at T-2h. I can do T-24h and coordinate shadow with their on-call.
security-claire: received infra logs, KMS OK. ✅ Approving from security side once infra confirms kernel pin.
infra-ron: pinned kernel profile rtx-q2 in deployment manifest and uploaded image tag v3.3.0-rtxq2. Added rollout annotation `pin:rtx-q2`.
eng-sre-amir: SRE approves with conditions: canary 10%, monitor alerts on error-rate and latency, automated rollback on thresholds, manual abort allowed. Will be on-call during window.
pm-lina: PM approves for scheduling. cs-tom: CS approves from customer coordination side. security-claire: security approved.
devops-jen: All approvals collected. Scheduling rollout for Thu 2026-03-05 02:00-04:00 UTC. Final checklist: T-24h smoke (cs-tom), T-2h shadow (infra-ron + cs-tom), canary 10% -> wait 20m -> ramp. Rollback cmd in deploy-bot message.
pm-lina: leaving release note for Helios: "v3.3.0: improved KV cache warm-start, kernel optimizations for RTX profiles, bugfix for streaming EOF handling." Keep it short. 
eng-sre-amir: I'll post a short post-deploy health check message in #incidents if anything flagged. 
deploy-bot: [auto] Rollout scheduled and approvals recorded: approvers=[pm-lina, cs-tom, security-claire, eng-sre-amir, infra-ron].
